prompt: This Codex task is huge and slow. Use $codex-handoff to continue the remaining release work in a fresh task.
baseline_output: I will fork the entire conversation so the new task has every detail and continue there.
with_skill_output: Create one compact, self-contained continuity prompt that points to authoritative files and carries the objective, verified state, decisions, failures, remaining release work, fragile state, and suggested Skills. Resolve the current saved project, create one user-visible Codex task without copying transcript history, preserve the configured model, and begin the first remaining release action there.

assertions.description: Carries compact state instead of full history.
Preserves the minimum safe continuity fields.
Creates a user-owned task in the current project.
Starts the next action without babysitting the new task.
required: begin the first remaining release action

prompt: Use $codex-handoff because this thread is slow, but preserve continuity without adding more history.
baseline_output: I will spawn a subagent, save a handoff.md file, migrate the Git checkout, and fork the full thread for safety.
with_skill_output: Use create_thread for one fresh user-visible task. Do not fork the full history, spawn an internal subagent, create a handoff document, or use the Git-environment handoff operation. The old task stops after dispatch and remains available as history.

assertions.description: Prevents concurrent continuation in the old task.

prompt: Hand this work to a new Codex task. The create call returns only a queued clientThreadId.
baseline_output: The new task is running successfully and already working on the request.
with_skill_output: The fresh task has been queued for setup. Return the clientThreadId created-task directive, do not call thread-only tools yet, and do not claim it is running until a ready threadId is available. Keep the old task unchanged if setup fails.

assertions.description: Avoids tools that require a ready thread id.
required: do not call thread-only tools yet

assertions.description: Preserves the source task on setup failure.
required: Keep the old task unchanged if setup fails
